v.1: Blessed is He in whose hands is all sovereignty, and He has power over all things.
v.2: He, who created death and life that He may test you [to see] which of you is best in conduct. And He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiving.
v.3: He created seven heavens in layers. You do not see any discordance in the creation of the All-beneficent. Look again! Do you see any flaw?
v.4: Look again, once more. Your look will return to you humbled and weary.
v.5: We have certainly adorned the lowest heaven with lamps, and made them [the means of pelting] missiles against the devils, and We have prepared for them a punishment of the Blaze.
v.6: For those who defy their Lord is the punishment of hell, and it is an evil destination.
v.7: When they are thrown in it, they hear it blaring, as it seethes,
v.8: almost exploding with rage. Whenever a group is thrown in it, its keepers will ask them, ‘Did not any warner come to you?’
v.9: They will say, ‘Yes, a warner did come to us, but we impugned [him] and said, ‘Allah did not send down anything; you are only in great error.’
v.10: And they will say, ‘Had we listened or applied reason, we would not have been among inmates of the Blaze.’
v.11: Thus they will admit their sin. So away with the inmates of the Blaze!
v.12: Indeed for those who fear their Lord in secret there will be forgiveness and a great reward.
v.13: Speak secretly, or do so openly, indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.
v.14: Would He who has created not know? And He is the All-attentive, the All-aware.
v.15: It is He who made the earth tractable for you; so walk on its flanks and eat of His provision, and towards Him is the resurrection.
v.16: Are you secure that He who is in the sky will not make the earth swallow you while it quakes?
v.17: Are you secure that He who is in the sky will not unleash upon you a rain of stones? Soon you will know how My warning has been!
v.18: Certainly those who were before them had impugned [My apostles]; but then how was My rebuttal!
v.19: Have they not regarded the birds above them spreading and closing their wings? No one sustains them except the All-beneficent. Indeed, He watches all things.
v.20: Who is it that is your host who may help you, besides the All-beneficent? The faithless only dwell in delusion.
v.21: Who is it that may provide for you if He withholds His provision? Indeed, they persist in defiance and aversion.
v.22: Is he who walks prone on his face better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?
v.23: Say, ‘It is He who created you, and made for you hearing, eyesight, and hearts. Little do you thank.’
v.24: Say, ‘It is He who created you on the earth, and toward Him you will be mustered.’
v.25: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?’
v.26: Say, ‘Its knowledge is only with Allah; I am only a manifest warner.’
v.27: When they see it brought near, the countenances of the faithless will be contorted, and [they will be] told, ‘This is what you were asking for!’
v.28: Say, ‘Tell me, whether Allah destroys me and those who are with me, or He has mercy on us, who will shelter the faithless from a painful punishment?’
v.29: Say, ‘He is the All-beneficent; we have faith in Him, and in Him do we trust. Soon you will know who is in manifest error.’
v.30: Say, ‘Tell me, should your water sink down [into the ground], who will bring you running water?’
